marketSummary: The Nifty 50 reclaimed momentum on November 16, 2026, advancing 0.58% to 25,291.10 after defending the 25,140 base. Market breadth was reinforced by strong institutional participation as Foreign Institutional Investors recorded net cash purchases of Rs 4,864.68 crore, reversing prior session outflows. Corporate fundamentals offered a reliable cushion with the conclusion of the Q2 FY27 earnings season revealing 28 out of 50 Nifty constituents beating Street estimates against only five misses. Swing setups favor capital goods, defence manufacturing, and selective consumer discretionary names demonstrating multi-week base breakouts backed by volume expansion.
dailyFocus: Multi-session consolidations breaking out near key moving averages across defence and power equipment leaders, buoyed by institutional inflows and robust order disclosures.

news.headline: FIIs Infuse Rs 4,864 Crore as Nifty 50 Reclaims 25,290 Post-Earnings Scorecard
news.summary: Indian benchmark indices rallied on November 16, 2026, led by net foreign portfolio inflows of Rs 4,864.68 crore in cash equities. The Q2 FY27 earnings season closed with 28 Nifty companies exceeding consensus forecasts and only five lagging, underpinning strong broad-market earnings resilience.
news.impact: Index defense above 25,150 lowers broad market drawdown risk and improves follow-through probability for individual stock breakouts.

news.headline: Hitachi Energy India Surges After Q2 Revenue Beats Street Estimates by 26%
news.summary: Hitachi Energy India reported a 64% YoY surge in Q2 FY27 revenue to Rs 2,997 crore, beating consensus by 26%, while operating EBITDA climbed 36% to Rs 406 crore and net profit rose 20% to Rs 319 crore. The order backlog reached historic highs due to high-voltage equipment demand and energy transition mandates.
news.impact: Triggers volume breakout gap-up above previous swing highs, setting a strong leading benchmark for power T&D peers.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics Secures Fresh Defence Orders Worth Rs 619 Crore
news.summary: Bharat Electronics Limited announced on November 13-16, 2026, that it received additional orders valued at Rs 619 crore for communication equipment, drones, electro-optics, laser range finders, components, upgrades, and services. This builds upon an earlier Rs 909 crore contract disclosed on November 6, taking the company's order book to Rs 68,717 crore.
news.impact: Provides immediate bullish momentum to support a multi-week cup-and-handle base breakout above key moving averages.

news.headline: Trent Posts 25% Jump in Q2 Profit to Rs 468 Crore; Milestone of 1,000 Zudio Stores Reached
news.summary: Trent Limited posted a 25.3% YoY rise in Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 468.09 crore on revenue of Rs 5,873.14 crore, driven by robust store expansions and mid-single-digit like-for-like sales growth. Standalone operating EBIT margins strengthened to 11.6% from 10.5%, with the company reaching 1,342 total stores including its 1,000th Zudio store.
news.impact: Confirms strong institutional accumulation and provides fundamental validation for swing continuation out of a high-tight flag.

news.headline: CG Power Approves Rs 68 Crore Transformer Expansion Amid Heavy Capacity Utilization
news.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions approved a 10,000 MVA power transformer capacity expansion at an investment of Rs 68 crore, expected to complete within 12 to 15 months via internal accruals. The expansion directly targets peak plant utilization, supported by strong transformer demand from domestic utilities and export traction.
news.impact: Strengthens structural multi-week base breakout as capacity additions unlock forward revenue ceiling in power equipment.

news.headline: HAL Clocks 16% YoY Net Profit Growth in Q2 FY27 With FY27 Margin Target Intact
news.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of Rs 7,613.25 crore, up 14.9% YoY, and consolidated PAT of Rs 1,935.64 crore, up 16% YoY. Management guided for full-year revenue growth of 10-12% and EBITDA margins between 30-31%, noting that 14 GE F404 engines have been secured with deliveries of around 10 LCA Mk1A jets targeted by March 2027.
news.impact: Supports price consolidation within an ascending base; clear delivery timeline addresses market overhang on jet deliveries.

news.headline: Ministry of Defence Inks Rs 498.58 Crore Refit Contract With Cochin Shipyard
news.summary: The Ministry of Defence signed a formal contract worth Rs 498.58 crore with Cochin Shipyard Limited on November 11, 2026, for the normal refit and re-powering of Indian Naval Ship INS Betwa. The 24-month project entails propulsion modernization from steam to diesel engines and combat system upgrades, supporting high-margin ship-repair revenue visibility against a total backlog exceeding Rs 21,900 crore.
news.impact: Counterbalances recent shipbuilding segment drag and establishes support near horizontal consolidation pivot levels.

news.headline: Amber Enterprises Rallies 12% on Strong Q2 Revenue Outperformance
news.summary: Amber Enterprises gained 12% on November 16, 2026, after Q2 FY27 revenue and operational numbers surpassed analyst estimates. Strong performance was driven by accelerating client onboarding in electronics manufacturing services, railway subsystems, and heating and ventilation units.
news.impact: High-volume expansion off multi-week range low creates a momentum pivot for a stage-one breakout attempt.

news.headline: Cabinet Committee on Security Clears Rs 40,000 Crore Corvette Programme for Indian Navy
news.summary: The Cabinet Committee on Security has cleared a Rs 40,000 crore procurement plan for eight Next-Generation Corvettes for the Indian Navy. The decision paves the way for extensive manufacturing subcontracts in combat management systems, radar systems, and ship platform construction over the next 3 to 5 years.
news.impact: Provides medium-term pipeline clarity that reinforces institutional accumulation across Tier-1 defence prime contractors.

news.headline: SoftBank SVF II Divests 1% Stake in Meesho via Rs 1,885 Crore Block Deal
news.summary: SoftBank SVF II offloaded approximately 76.4 million shares (around 1% equity) in Meesho at a floor price of Rs 246.75 per share on November 13, 2026. Institutional participants including Morgan Stanley, Societe Generale, Motilal Oswal MF, and HDFC MF stepped in as buyers, with purchased shares subject to a 30-day lock-in period.
news.impact: Supply overhang is absorbed by institutional buyers, establishing a firm volume-weighted average price floor for base formation.
